Remark
[Submersions with totally geodesic fibers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0228 ↗ thm:chow-ii-oneill-curvature-formulas 1. ch13:13.11\group Riemannian Submersions

If every fiber is totally geodesic, then $T=0$ and \[ K_{\mathcal X}(U,V)=K_{\mathcal Z}(U,V),\quad K_{\mathcal X}(U,X)=\frac{|A_XU|^2}{|U\wedge X|^2}, \] \[ K_{\mathcal X}(X,Y)=K_{\mathcal Y}(\pi _*X,\pi _*Y) -3\frac{|A_XY|^2}{|X\wedge Y|^2}. \]
